name: systematic-document-analysis
description: Repeat one task independently across files with controlled CLI/API workers and an audit trail.

interface.longDescription: Define one task and run an independent CLI or API worker per file. The task determines the result; instructions, settings, sources, errors and raw responses stay traceable. Works in English or Norwegian in Codex and Claude Code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me analyse my documents with Systematic Document Analysis.
